method: Screened every prompt and chosen/rejected completion in the 1,415 non-Safety cases with broad category expressions, then contextually reviewed high-signal matches, selected broader-topic matches, and every reported case. The 450-case Safety subset was counted but not individually rated because it is deliberately harmful and receives a universal gate. Neutral academic, historical, political, religious, and medical discussion was not treated as offensive without concrete distressing, degrading, explicit, or unsafe content.

coverage.limitations: Manual contextual review was concentrated on high-signal triage matches, selected broader-topic matches, and all reported cases. It was not independent sentence-by-sentence annotation of every completion, and category expressions produced both false positives and misses that required judgment.
